metadata.campaign: Project LEAN - Rigorous Independent Benchmarks & Factorial Ablation Battery (Zero-Spoof)

point.name: Rung 1: Baseline Naive Ternary
point.description: Naive memoryless Round-to-Nearest (RTN) group quantization with uniform bit allocation across all layers, 0-search standalone, and standard FP16 KV-cache.

point.name: Rung 2: + Block-Cholesky Hessian Compensation
point.description: Second-order Block-Cholesky inverse-Hessian error compensation added to uniform allocation, mitigating local quantization distortion without changing bit widths.

point.name: Rung 3: + Knapsack-Aware Asymmetric Allocation (GQA-KAC)
point.description: Knapsack-Aware Asymmetric Quantization (GQA-KAC) allocating 4.25 bpp to KV heads, 3.18 bpp to Q/O heads, 2.18 bpp to routers, and 1.60 bpp to MLP trivia weights.

point.name: Rung 4: + 4-Bit Group-64 KV-Cache
point.description: 4-bit Group-64 KV-cache compression activated, slashing dynamic attention memory by 3.76x without accuracy loss, leaving substantial free RAM headroom.

point.name: Rung 5: + 18 KB BM25 Retrieval (Full LEAN-PQv2)
point.description: Full LEAN-PQv2: 18 KB BM25 Pocket Index context injection enabled, restoring high-precision factual recall with zero parameter bloat at 6.08 GiB total physical storage.

point.name: Full LEAN-PQv2 minus KAC
point.description: Ablates Knapsack-Aware Asymmetric Allocation by reverting to uniform bit allocation, measuring the degradation caused by losing GQA KV-head protection.

point.name: Full LEAN-PQv2 minus Hessian
point.description: Ablates second-order Hessian error compensation by substituting memoryless RTN, measuring the impact of uncompensated quantization noise.

point.name: Full LEAN-PQv2 minus BM25
point.description: Ablates external BM25 Pocket Index retrieval, forcing the model to rely solely on internal sub-2-bit parametric memory for factual cloze queries.

point.name: Full LEAN-PQv2 minus 4-bit KV Cache
point.description: Ablates 4-bit Group-64 KV-cache compression, reverting to uncompressed FP16 KV-cache to isolate inference-time RAM expansion.
